<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Maranatha — Grupo de Jovens</title>
<meta name="description" content="Maranatha, grupo de jovens: oração, Eucaristia e amizade. Fale com a gente pelo WhatsApp ou pelo Instagram.">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#170a2b">
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 24 24'%3E%3Crect width='24' height='24' rx='5' fill='%234a1f8a'/%3E%3Cpath d='M13 2 5 13.5h6L10 22l9-12h-6z' fill='%23d8a935'/%3E%3C/svg%3E">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cinzel:wght@500;700;900&family=Source+Sans+3:wght@400;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --night:#170a2b; --violet:#2b1052; --purple:#4a1f8a; --amethyst:#7a4bc4;
  --gold:#d8a935; --gold-light:#f0d58a; --cream:#f7f0df; --ink:#24103f;
  --serif:"Cinzel","Trajan Pro","Times New Roman",serif;
  --sans:"Source Sans 3","Segoe UI",system-ui,-apple-system,Roboto,sans-serif;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:72px;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{margin:0;background:var(--night);color:var(--cream);font:400 1.0625rem/1.65 var(--sans);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
img{display:block;max-width:100%}
a{color:inherit}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--gold-light);outline-offset:3px}
.wrap{width:min(1120px, 100% - 2.5rem);margin-inline:auto}

/* topo */
.top{position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;z-index:20;background:rgba(23,10,43,.86);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(216,169,53,.3)}
.top .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:64px}
.brand{font:700 1.15rem var(--serif);letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--gold);text-decoration:none}
.nav{display:flex;gap:1.9rem}
.nav a{text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;color:var(--cream);padding:.3rem 0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent}
.nav a:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold-light)}
.menu-btn{display:none;width:44px;height:44px;place-content:center;gap:5px;background:none;border:1px solid rgba(216,169,53,.5);border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer}
.menu-btn span{display:block;width:22px;height:2px;background:var(--gold)}

/* botões */
.actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.9rem}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;padding:.9rem 1.5rem;border-radius:999px;border:2px solid var(--gold);font:600 1rem var(--sans);text-decoration:none;transition:background .2s,color .2s}
.btn svg{width:1.2rem;height:1.2rem;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.btn-gold{background:var(--gold);color:var(--night)}
.btn-gold:hover{background:var(--gold-light)}
.btn-line{color:var(--gold-light)}
.btn-line:hover{background:rgba(216,169,53,.16)}

/* hero */
.hero{padding:104px 0 64px;background:
  radial-gradient(900px 600px at 82% 28%,rgba(122,75,196,.42),transparent 70%),
  radial-gradient(700px 520px at 0% 100%,rgba(74,31,138,.6),transparent 70%),
  var(--night)}
.hero .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:3rem;align-items:center}
.stack{margin:0 0 1.5rem;font:900 clamp(3.2rem,10vw,6.4rem)/.96 var(--serif);letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--gold)}
.stack .ln{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.3em}
.stack .t{display:block}
@supports ((-webkit-background-clip:text) or (background-clip:text)){
  .stack .t{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gold-light),var(--gold) 55%,#a87c1c);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;color:transparent}
}
.bolt{height:.62em;width:auto;fill:var(--gold);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 .22em rgba(240,213,138,.75));animation:flash 1.1s .3s both}
@keyframes flash{0%{opacity:0}10%{opacity:1}18%{opacity:.15}28%{opacity:1}40%{opacity:.35}55%,100%{opacity:1}}
.kind{margin:0 0 .6rem;font:500 clamp(1.3rem,3vw,1.7rem)/1.3 var(--serif);color:var(--gold-light);letter-spacing:.06em}
.meaning{margin:0 0 2rem;max-width:30rem;color:#e5dcef;font-size:1.15rem}
.arch{justify-self:center;width:min(100%,380px);aspect-ratio:3/4;border-radius:999px 999px 14px 14px;overflow:hidden;border:3px solid var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 0 10px rgba(216,169,53,.12),0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.55)}
.arch img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}

/* seções */
.sec{padding:clamp(4rem,9vw,7rem) 0}
.sec h2{margin:0 0 1.25rem;font:700 clamp(1.8rem,4.5vw,2.8rem)/1.15 var(--serif);color:var(--gold)}
.sec p{margin:0 0 1.1rem}

.about{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--violet),#20093f)}
.about .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr 1fr;gap:clamp(2rem,5vw,4.5rem);align-items:center}
.frame{position:relative;isolation:isolate}
.frame img{width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:6px}
.frame::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:14px -14px -14px 14px;border:2px solid var(--gold);border-radius:6px;z-index:-1}

.live{background:var(--night)}
.live ul{list-style:none;margin:2rem 0 0;padding:0;border-top:1px solid rgba(216,169,53,.4)}
.live li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.9fr) minmax(0,1.4fr);gap:.6rem 2rem;padding:1.6rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(216,169,53,.4)}
.live h3{margin:0;font:700 1.3rem/1.3 var(--serif);color:var(--gold-light)}
.live li p{margin:0;color:#e5dcef}

.gal{--gap:12px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#20093f,var(--violet))}
.mosaic{columns:2;column-gap:var(--gap);margin-top:2rem}
.shot{display:block;width:100%;margin:0 0 var(--gap);padding:0;border:0;background:none;cursor:zoom-in;break-inside:avoid;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden}
.shot img{width:100%;height:auto;transition:transform .4s}
.shot:hover img{transform:scale(1.03)}

.lb{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:50;display:none;place-items:center;padding:1rem;background:rgba(10,4,22,.95)}
.lb.on{display:grid}
.lb img{max-width:100%;max-height:88vh;width:auto;height:auto;border:2px solid var(--gold);border-radius:6px}
.lb button{position:absolute;top:1rem;right:1rem;width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--gold);background:var(--night);color:var(--gold);font-size:1.6rem;line-height:1;cursor:pointer}

.contact{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#e8c053,var(--gold) 55%,#b98a22);color:var(--ink);text-align:center}
.contact h2{color:var(--ink)}
.contact p{max-width:34rem;margin:0 auto 2rem;font-size:1.2rem}
.contact .actions{justify-content:center}
.btn-dark{background:var(--violet);border-color:var(--violet);color:var(--gold-light)}
.btn-dark:hover{background:var(--night);border-color:var(--night)}
.btn-ghost{border-color:var(--ink);color:var(--ink)}
.btn-ghost:hover{background:rgba(36,16,63,.12)}
.contact .num{margin:1.4rem auto 0;font-size:1rem;font-weight:600}

.foot{padding:2.2rem 0;background:var(--night);text-align:center;border-top:1px solid rgba(216,169,53,.3);color:#b9a8d6;font-size:.95rem}
.foot b{display:block;margin-bottom:.3rem;font:700 1.1rem var(--serif);letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--gold)}

@media (min-width:900px){
  .hero{min-height:100svh;display:grid;align-items:center}
  .gal{--gap:16px}
  .mosaic{columns:3}
}
@media (max-width:860px){
  .hero .wrap,.about .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .arch{width:min(78%,320px)}
  .frame{margin-right:14px}
}
@media (max-width:760px){
  .menu-btn{display:grid}
  .nav{position:absolute;top:64px;left:0;right:0;display:none;flex-direction:column;gap:0;padding:.4rem 1.25rem 1rem;background:var(--night);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(216,169,53,.3)}
  .nav.open{display:flex}
  .nav a{padding:.9rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(216,169,53,.18)}
  .live li{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .btn{width:100%;justify-content:center}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  *{animation:none!important;transition:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header class="top">
  <div class="wrap">
    <a class="brand" href="#inicio">MARANATHA</a>
    <button class="menu-btn" aria-label="Abrir menu" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="nav"><span></span><span></span><span></span></button>
    <nav class="nav" id="nav" aria-label="Principal">
      <a href="#quem-somos">Quem somos</a>
      <a href="#vivemos">O que vivemos</a>
      <a href="#fotos">Fotos</a>
      <a href="#contato">Contato</a>
    </nav>
  </div>
</header>

<main>
  <section class="hero" id="inicio">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div>
        <h1 class="stack" aria-label="Maranatha">
          <span class="ln" aria-hidden="true"><span class="t">MA</span></span>
          <span class="ln" aria-hidden="true"><span class="t">RA</span>
            <svg class="bolt" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M13 2 4.5 13.6H11L9.8 22 19.5 9.8H13z"/></svg></span>
          <span class="ln" aria-hidden="true"><span class="t">NA</span></span>
          <span class="ln" aria-hidden="true"><span class="t">THA</span></span>
        </h1>
        <p class="kind">Grupo de Jovens</p>
        <p class="meaning">Maranatha é uma palavra aramaica que significa “Vem, Senhor!”</p>
        <div class="actions">
          <a class="btn btn-gold" href="https://wa.me/5543996087018?text=Ol%C3%A1!%20Quero%20conhecer%20o%20grupo%20de%20jovens%20Maranatha." target="_blank" rel="noopener">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M21 11.5a8.38 8.38 0 0 1-.9 3.8 8.5 8.5 0 0 1-7.6 4.7 8.38 8.38 0 0 1-3.8-.9L3 21l1.9-5.7a8.38 8.38 0 0 1-.9-3.8 8.5 8.5 0 0 1 4.7-7.6 8.38 8.38 0 0 1 3.8-.9h.5a8.48 8.48 0 0 1 8 8v.5z"/></svg>
            Chamar no WhatsApp</a>
          <a class="btn btn-line" href="https://www.instagram.com/gj.maranatha_" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="2" y="2" width="20" height="20" rx="5"/><path d="M16 11.37A4 4 0 1 1 12.63 8 4 4 0 0 1 16 11.37z"/><path d="M17.5 6.5h.01"/></svg>
            Seguir no Instagram</a>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="arch">
        <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," width="760" height="1142" alt="Crucifixo na parede da igreja, iluminado por um feixe de luz">
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="sec about" id="quem-somos">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="frame">
        <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," width="1100" height="825" loading="lazy" alt="Jovens do Maranatha de camiseta roxa fazendo o sinal do grupo, ao lado do padre, na capela">
      </div>
      <div>
        <h2>Jovens que rezam juntos</h2>
        <p>O Maranatha é um grupo de jovens da Igreja Católica que se reúne para rezar, celebrar a Missa e viver a amizade em comunidade. Aqui você chega como está e encontra gente disposta a caminhar com você.</p>
        <p>Vestimos roxo e carregamos o grito que dá nome ao grupo: Vem, Senhor!</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="sec live" id="vivemos">
    <div class="wrap">
      <h2>O que vivemos juntos</h2>
      <ul>
        <li><h3>Santa Missa</h3><p>Participamos da Eucaristia em comunidade, no coração da vida do grupo.</p></li>
        <li><h3>Adoração ao Santíssimo</h3><p>Momentos de silêncio e louvor diante de Jesus Eucaristia.</p></li>
        <li><h3>Oração e partilha</h3><p>Rezamos, conversamos sobre a Palavra e aprendemos a viver a fé no dia a dia.</p></li>
        <li><h3>Amizade e serviço</h3><p>Construímos amizades de verdade e levamos o que vivemos para a comunidade.</p></li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="sec gal" id="fotos">
    <div class="wrap">
      <h2>Nossos momentos</h2>
      <div class="mosaic">
        <button class="shot" type="button"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," width="1200" height="675" loading="lazy" alt="Jovens do Maranatha, padres e coroinhas reunidos em volta do altar depois da Missa"></button>
        <button class="shot" type="button"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," width="760" height="1351" loading="lazy" alt="Jovens em adoração diante do Santíssimo Sacramento"></button>
        <button class="shot" type="button"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," width="760" height="1142" loading="lazy" alt="Dois jovens de camiseta roxa do Maranatha rezando de mãos juntas"></button>
        <button class="shot" type="button"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," width="760" height="1142" loading="lazy" alt="Pintura de Cristo sentado, com o livro “Eu sou” nas mãos"></button>
        <button class="shot" type="button"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," width="760" height="1142" loading="lazy" alt="Capela do Santíssimo vista pelo arco da igreja"></button>
        <button class="shot" type="button"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," width="760" height="1142" loading="lazy" alt="Altar com a cruz e as velas acesas"></button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="sec contact" id="contato">
    <div class="wrap">
      <h2>Vem com a gente</h2>
      <p>Quer participar ou saber quando é o próximo encontro? Manda uma mensagem.</p>
      <div class="actions">
        <a class="btn btn-dark" href="https://wa.me/5543996087018?text=Ol%C3%A1!%20Quero%20conhecer%20o%20grupo%20de%20jovens%20Maranatha." target="_blank" rel="noopener">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M21 11.5a8.38 8.38 0 0 1-.9 3.8 8.5 8.5 0 0 1-7.6 4.7 8.38 8.38 0 0 1-3.8-.9L3 21l1.9-5.7a8.38 8.38 0 0 1-.9-3.8 8.5 8.5 0 0 1 4.7-7.6 8.38 8.38 0 0 1 3.8-.9h.5a8.48 8.48 0 0 1 8 8v.5z"/></svg>
          Chamar no WhatsApp</a>
        <a class="btn btn-ghost" href="https://www.instagram.com/gj.maranatha_" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="2" y="2" width="20" height="20" rx="5"/><path d="M16 11.37A4 4 0 1 1 12.63 8 4 4 0 0 1 16 11.37z"/><path d="M17.5 6.5h.01"/></svg>
          @gj.maranatha_</a>
      </div>
      <p class="num">WhatsApp: (43) 99608-7018</p>
    </div>
  </section>
</main>

<footer class="foot">
  <div class="wrap">
    <b>Maranatha — Vem, Senhor!</b>
    © 2026 Grupo de Jovens Maranatha
  </div>
</footer>

<div class="lb" id="lb" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Foto ampliada">
  <img src="" alt="">
  <button type="button" aria-label="Fechar foto">×</button>
</div>

<script>
(function(){
  var btn=document.querySelector('.menu-btn'), nav=document.getElementById('nav');
  btn.addEventListener('click',function(){
    var open=nav.classList.toggle('open');
    btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded',open);
  });
  nav.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    if(e.target.tagName==='A'){nav.classList.remove('open');btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded',false);}
  });

  var lb=document.getElementById('lb'), big=lb.querySelector('img'), x=lb.querySelector('button');
  function close(){lb.classList.remove('on');}
  document.querySelectorAll('.shot').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click',function(){
      var i=b.querySelector('img');
      big.src=i.src; big.alt=i.alt;
      lb.classList.add('on'); x.focus();
    });
  });
  lb.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(e.target!==big)close();});
  document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape')close();});
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
